blocks.p: *Options* opens on *ZeD setup*, the first page in the list at the left of the window. The game's own pages follow it: *Display*, *Graphics*, *Audio*, *Controls*, *Gameplay*, *Interface*, *Accessibility* and *Mods*. *ZeD setup* begins with *Look*, shown in Figure 48-1.

caption: Figure 48-1
The Look section, at the top of ZeD setup.

blocks.p: Below *Look* come the sections *Full or simple*, *Additions*, *Windows*, *HUD*, *Controls*, *Quick actions (controller)* and *Troubleshooting*. The buttons at the foot of the window are *Back*, *Reset to defaults*, *Discard changes* and *Apply*.

blocks.note: Each setting is explained in the band above the buttons, with its default.

marks.text: Theme, accent, text size, see-through and UI scale: radio buttons, swatches and sliders.

blocks.p: *Hidden actions*, under *Windows*, sets what is done with the actions you cannot take right now: *Folded* puts them under a hint row you can open, *Show all, grayed* shows every one grayed out, and *Hide* shows none of them.

caption: Figure 48-2
ZeD setup, top, and the Interface page.

marks.text: Hidden actions is a pop-up menu: Folded, Show all or Hide.
Every setting is explained in the band at the foot.
Game settings ZeD replaces are grayed out and say so.

sticky.text: The game's pages say what ZeD replaces.
